contenders.handicapper_notes: Brings the highest class baseline in the race, having competed creditably in Morphettville juvenile stakes and BM66 grade earlier this year. Hit the line strongly when 4th first-up at this venue over 1100m after being held up at the 300m, then contested a Saturday metro maiden at Morphettville Parks over 1400m. Reaches peak 3rd-up fitness stepping up to 1500m and draws ideally in barrier 2 to stalk right behind the speed on Gawler short 300m straight.

Victorian shipper from the leading Phillip and Tommy Stokes stable making South Australian debut. Finished 5.5L 7th at Pakenham over 1400m against significantly stronger maiden company, which represents a decisive class drop into SA provincial grade. Jason Holder takes over riding duties; maps to track into the race with tactical cover and poses the prime winning danger.

First-up from a 3-month spell but lands the coveted fence run from barrier 1 under Opperman. Demonstrated staying ability over this trip and beyond last prep, including a narrow 0.4L 2nd over 1600m at Strathalbyn and a 4th beaten 0.3L in Gawler Class 1 company. If he jumps cleanly, he gets the softest pocket trail around the home turn.

Experienced maiden dropping back from Saturday metropolitan grade at Morphettville where he finished 6th over 1200m. Proven over this exact track and 1500m distance when 4th beaten 1.9L in September with a competitive speed rating. Sustained swooper profile fits well into trifecta calculations.

Beneficiary of the post-scratch pace dynamic as the lone confirmed natural front-runner (E) in the active field. Receives 2kg weight relief via apprentice Jessica Booth down to 56kg. However, his overall form figures remain modest and he tends to tire late on undulating uphill home straights.

Improved sharply last start when finishing runner-up beaten a length at Mildura over 1300m. Todd Pannell takes the reins, which is a key jockey upgrade, but he must prove he can handle the extra 200m journey after fading out when tested over this course and distance two starts back.

contenders.handicapper_notes: Running style E. Post-scratch Lone Speed (+6) with #2 scratched and no other true front-runners in the field. Dominant 7.5L maiden winner over 1700m here on Good 4 last start (SR 61), and Gawler's 300m uphill straight with the +5m rail favors uncontested early speed. Effective weight 59.0 kg at 2100m is a slight tax (-2.0 pts) on his first try at the trip, but controlling the tempo puts him in the firing line.

Running style P. Maps to stalk #3 Nunya directly from the one-off spot. Already beat Nunya by 1.8L first-up at Murray Bridge (1800m) and reaches 2nd-up peak fitness (+1.5 pts) stepping up to her proven 2100m distance (two placings at 2000m-2100m). Receives a 3.0 kg apprentice claim down to 54.0 kg net (+2.0 pts relief), giving her a decisive 5.0 kg weight advantage over Nunya.

Running style P. Possesses superior metro back-class (G3 3rd at 2000m with SR 92 in April; Metro BM68 SR 72-73 recently) and drops sharply in grade into a Country Class 1, though beaten 7.0L in a Morphettville Cl2 over 1600m last start. Draws barrier 5 (+1.5 pts with +5m rail) to camp just behind the speed, and steps back up to a staying trip where he has excelled. 59.0 kg weight tax (-2.0 pts) tempers confidence slightly.

Running style S. Progressive staying mare flagged as the Danger Horse. Finished a close 3rd (beaten 0.2L, SR 59) over 2000m at Strathalbyn last start after being held up near the 400m mark, and has placed twice at 2000m. Draws barrier 4 (+1.5 pts with +5m rail) with a light 55.0 kg weight; if she secures clear air in the 300m straight, she can threaten late.
